horizonmatica.credits.1: Horizonmatica is a Horizon re-creation of Litematica. All credit for the idea and design goes to:
horizonmatica.credits.2: Litematica by masa (maruohon), github.com/maruohon/litematica, maintained by Sakura-Ryoko (github.com/sakura-ryoko/litematica)
horizonmatica.credits.3: Litematica Printer by aleksilassila, github.com/aleksilassila/litematica-printer (maintained by Sakura-Ryoko)
horizonmatica.credits.4: Horizon by the horizon-rust team, github.com/horizon-rust/horizon
horizonmatica.credits.5: File formats: Litematica (.litematic), Sponge/WorldEdit (.schem), MCEdit (.schematic), Mojang (structure .nbt)
horizonmatica.credits.6: No code was copied from Litematica or the printer; it is not made or endorsed by their authors.
horizonmatica.chat.menu_blocked: The menu opens over the game only: close the open screen first
horizonmatica.err.outside_world: the placement would reach outside the world (x and z %s to %s, y %s to %s)
horizonmatica.chat.credit_note: Horizonmatica is based on Litematica by masa (maruohon) & Sakura-Ryoko and the Litematica Printer by aleksilassila. /hm credits
horizonmatica.chat.upgraded: · %s block states updated from data version %s
horizonmatica.help.1: /horizonmatica list | load <name> | unload [all] | reload | folder | info
horizonmatica.help.2: /horizonmatica placements | select <n>|next|prev | show [on|off] | hide | lock [on|off] | unlock
horizonmatica.help.3: /horizonmatica origin here | origin <x> <y> <z> | move <dx> <dy> <dz> | rotate cw|ccw|180|none | mirror none|x|z
horizonmatica.help.4: /horizonmatica pos1|pos2 [here | <x> <y> <z>] (default: the block you look at) | area [clear] | save <name> [overwrite] | save cancel|status
horizonmatica.help.5: /horizonmatica tool on|off|<item> | tool mode area|placement: the selection tool (a stick)
horizonmatica.help.6: /horizonmatica layer all | <y> | above <y> | below <y> | range <a> <b> | up | down | here
horizonmatica.help.7: /horizonmatica render on|off | through on|off | mode ghost|boxes | verify | materials [on|off] | materials copy
horizonmatica.help.9: /horizonmatica highlight missing|wrong [on|off] | highlight item <item>|all | highlight off
horizonmatica.help.10: /horizonmatica printer on|off | air on|off | speed <ticks> | reach <blocks>
horizonmatica.help.11: /horizonmatica easyplace on|off | easyplace every <ticks> | easyplace air on|off: hold right click to place the block the schematic wants
horizonmatica.help.12: /horizonmatica credits: who made the original Litematica and its printer
horizonmatica.err.placement_ambiguous: "%s" matches %s placements: use its number (/hm placements)
horizonmatica.chat.locked: %s locked: it can't be moved, turned or mirrored (/hm unlock)
horizonmatica.chat.hidden: %s hidden (stays loaded; /hm show brings it back)
horizonmatica.err.tool_mode: tool mode area or placement, not %s
horizonmatica.chat.tool_placement_mode: Selection tool: placement mode · left click selects, right click moves it there, Alt+wheel moves, Ctrl+wheel turns
horizonmatica.chat.tool_area_mode: Selection tool: area mode · left click corner 1, right click corner 2
horizonmatica.chat.tool_on: Selection tool ON: %s in hand · left click corner 1, right click corner 2
horizonmatica.chat.tool_off: Selection tool OFF (/hm pos1 and /hm pos2 still set the corners)
horizonmatica.err.usage_save: usage: /horizonmatica save <name> [overwrite] | save cancel | save status
horizonmatica.chat.info: %s (%s of %s) — origin %s %s %s, rotation %s, mirror %s, box %s..%s, layer %s
horizonmatica.chat.tally: %s%% done: %s correct, %s missing, %s wrong block, %s wrong state, %s extra%s
horizonmatica.err.radius: radius in blocks or view, not %s
horizonmatica.chat.radius_view: Render radius: the view distance (%s blocks)
horizonmatica.err.faces: a number of faces (300k, 2m...) or none, not %s
horizonmatica.err.not_in_list: %s isn't in the selected schematic's material list
horizonmatica.err.highlight: highlight missing, wrong, item or off, not %s
horizonmatica.chat.printer_air_on: Printer air place ON — places without a neighbouring block
horizonmatica.chat.printer_on: Printer ON — places missing blocks within reach
horizonmatica.chat.easy_speed: Easy place: one block every %s ticks
horizonmatica.chat.easy_air_on: Easy air place ON — ghost blocks need no neighbouring block
horizonmatica.chat.easy_on: Easy place ON — hold right click to place what the schematic wants
horizonmatica.chat.move_locked: Move mode: the placement is locked (/hm unlock)
horizonmatica.chat.move_on: Move mode ON: wheel = along your view, arrows = horizontal, Page up/down = up/down, R = rotate, Home = to you, Shift = 5 blocks. N or Enter: done
horizonmatica.chat.no_placement_there: No placement there (look at one's box)
horizonmatica.hud.tool_placement_1: Placement tool: left click selects the placement you look at · right click moves it there
horizonmatica.hud.tool_placement_2: Alt+wheel moves it · Ctrl+wheel turns it · Shift: 5 · Ctrl+middle click: area mode
horizonmatica.hud.tool_area_1: Selection tool: left click corner 1 · right click corner 2 · middle click picks a corner
horizonmatica.hud.tool_area_2: Alt+wheel moves %s · Ctrl+wheel grows/shrinks where you look · Shift: 5 · Ctrl+middle click: placement mode
horizonmatica.err.still_saving: %s is still being saved (/hm save cancel stops it)
horizonmatica.err.no_corners: set both corners first (the selection tool, or /hm pos1 and /hm pos2)
horizonmatica.err.area_too_large: the area is too large to save
horizonmatica.err.area_volume: the area has %s blocks; at most %s can be saved at once
horizonmatica.chat.saving: Saving %s: %s x %s x %s, chunks: %s (the HUD shows the progress)
horizonmatica.chat.save_left_world: Saving %s stopped: you left the world it is in
horizonmatica.chat.saved: Saved %s: %s x %s x %s, %s blocks, %s block states (%s s)
horizonmatica.err.writing: the file is being written; that can't be stopped
horizonmatica.err.no_items: no schematic loaded, or it needs no items
horizonmatica.materials.table_header: Item	Missing	Total	Carried	To fetch	Item ID
horizonmatica.err.clipboard: the clipboard can't be written right now
horizonmatica.chat.copied: Material list copied (%s kinds): paste it into a spreadsheet
horizonmatica.hud.move_mode: MOVE MODE · wheel/arrows/PgUp/PgDn · R rotate · N done
horizonmatica.hud.easy_place: Easy place ON: only the schematic's blocks
horizonmatica.menu.load.load_here_tip: Places it at your feet (or click the file twice)
horizonmatica.menu.load.pick: Pick a file on the left. Put .litematic, .schem, .schematic and .nbt files into the schematics folder.
horizonmatica.menu.load.reload_tip: Loads the last schematic again where it was
horizonmatica.menu.pl.load_more_tip: Another schematic, as one more placement
horizonmatica.menu.pl.hide_tip: Hidden placements stay loaded but aren't drawn or printed
horizonmatica.menu.pl.lock_tip_1: Locked: it can't be moved, turned or mirrored
horizonmatica.menu.pl.lock_tip_2: (neither here, nor by commands or the tool)
horizonmatica.menu.pl.unload_tip: Removes this placement (the world stays as it is)
horizonmatica.menu.pl.move_mode_tip: Wheel, arrows and PgUp/PgDn move it in the world (N)
horizonmatica.menu.pl.tool_tip_1: Placement mode: left click selects the placement looked at,
horizonmatica.menu.pl.tool_tip_2: right click moves the selected one there, Alt+wheel moves it,
horizonmatica.menu.pl.tool_tip_3: Ctrl+wheel turns it. Ctrl+middle click switches the mode.
horizonmatica.menu.save.title: Area selection: two opposite corners of the box to save
horizonmatica.menu.save.name: Name
horizonmatica.menu.save.look_tip: The block you look at (/hm pos1, /hm pos2)
horizonmatica.menu.save.save_tip_1: Saves the area as a .litematic into the schematics folder
horizonmatica.menu.save.save_tip_2: (chunk by chunk, as they are loaded)
horizonmatica.menu.save.cancel_tip: Stops the save; nothing is written
horizonmatica.menu.save.tool_tip: Opens the Tool tab: which item, its reach, its controls
horizonmatica.menu.save.tool_hint: With the %s in hand: left click corner 1, right click corner 2.
horizonmatica.menu.save.note: Saves the blocks with their states, as Litematica reads them. Not saved: what is inside chests, sign texts and entities.
horizonmatica.menu.tool.title: Selection tool: %s
horizonmatica.menu.tool.off: Off: clicks with it break and use as usual
horizonmatica.menu.tool.in_hand: On, and in your hand: click blocks to set the corners
horizonmatica.menu.tool.on: On: take it in your main hand to select
horizonmatica.menu.tool.item: Item: pick one, type its id, or take the one in your hand
horizonmatica.menu.tool.held_tip: The item in your main hand becomes the tool
horizonmatica.menu.tool.help_1: Left click: corner 1. Right click: corner 2.
horizonmatica.menu.tool.help_2: Middle click: pick a corner. Alt+wheel: move it.
horizonmatica.menu.tool.help_3: Ctrl+wheel: grow or shrink where you look.
horizonmatica.menu.printer.note: Survival: the blocks must be in your hotbar. On servers, automatic placing may break rules or trip anti-cheat.
horizonmatica.menu.display.stats: Overlay: %s faces in %s sections, ~%s MiB video memory · radius %s blocks%s
horizonmatica.menu.mat.hud_tip: The list in the corner while playing (J)
horizonmatica.menu.mat.copy_tip: Copies the list as a table: paste it into a spreadsheet
horizonmatica.menu.mat.empty: No schematic loaded, or it needs no items.
horizonmatica.menu.mat.highlight_tip: Marks them through everything, however far
horizonmatica.menu.mat.only_tip: Click a row below to mark only that item, again to mark all
horizonmatica.menu.credits.title: Horizonmatica re-creates Litematica for Horizon.
horizonmatica.menu.credits.all_credit: All credit for the idea and design goes to:
horizonmatica.menu.credits.not_endorsed: Not made or endorsed by them. No code copied: format and behaviour re-created.
horizonmatica.menu.credits.keys: The menu's keys are in Options > Controls (Horizonmatica).
horizonmatica.printer.waits_below: %s at %s %s %s waits for the block below
horizonmatica.printer.would_fall: %s at %s %s %s would fall: nothing below in the schematic
horizonmatica.printer.observer: observer at %s %s %s waits for what it watches
horizonmatica.printer.axis: %s at %s %s %s only goes against a block on its %s side, with that face in view
horizonmatica.printer.unsupported: Blocks waiting for a neighbour to click against (air place is off): %s
horizonmatica.printer.stuck: Blocks that can't be placed as wanted from where you stand: %s
horizonmatica.printer.no_way: no way to place %s at %s %s %s as wanted
horizonmatica.easy.lonely: %s: no block next to it (easy air place is off)
horizonmatica.easy.cant: %s can't go there as wanted from here
horizonmatica.hand.not_hotbar: in the inventory but not the hotbar
horizonmatica.hand.busy: the inventory can't be changed right now
horizonmatica.overlay.full: overlay full (%s): raise the face limit or lower the render radius
